facts: 24 bents: 16 single and four double H groups
Embankment side slopes 1.5 horizontal to 1 vertical
Typical footing width 3 m and length 5 to 6 m
Footing centre spacing 11 m and embedment 1.5 m
Figure 2 support rhythm and low north anchorage

estimates: No as-built north-approach alignment, deck profile or exact bent stations were available. The measured suspension-bridge axis is extended straight for the source length.
Bent station weights and four double-bent locations follow the rhythm in the schematic Figure 2. They are visual estimates, not digitized survey positions.
The deck begins at the exact existing endpoint and width. It transitions over 30 m to the 14.3 m source width. Its height tends to regional ground plus the documented 15 m embankment height.
Member sizes, rail detail, anchor-block dimensions and 100 m terminal embankment apron are visual estimates.
The terminal apron is a bounded mound tied to source ground. No north highway interchange or forest is inferred.

Coastal infill covers only omitted original 160 m grid triangles clipped to the source FWA land polygon. Heights use the same triangle-plane interpolation as the original regional mesh, not new measured detail.
Coastal infill starts at local north 1600 m, beyond the measured near-terrain crop at 1599 m, to avoid overlapping the protected near terrain.
